## Install

**Android** (15 or later): download the `.apk` on your phone and open it. Allow your browser or file manager to install
unknown apps when Android asks.

**Mac** (macOS 26 or later): download the `-macOS.zip`, unzip it and move **DroidDrop** to Applications. The app is not
notarized, so the first launch is blocked: open **System Settings › Privacy & Security**, click **Open Anyway** next to
DroidDrop, then confirm. DroidDrop lives in the menu bar.

Then choose **Pair New Phone…** in the Mac menu and scan the QR code with the Android app.
